title: Update site header to use the newly uploaded Kleenora logo

requirements.text: Update the site header branding to use the newly uploaded logo image file (navbar-1.png) as the header logo, replacing the currently referenced logo asset, and ensure no extra header text is added alongside the logo.
acceptanceCriteria: The header logo image source no longer points to the old logo asset (currently "/assets/generated/kleenora-logo.dim_512x200.png").
The header displays the uploaded image navbar-1.png as the site logo on both desktop and mobile.
No additional text label is rendered next to/around the logo in the header.
The logo loads successfully in production build without broken-image fallback.

constraints: Frontend paths listed as immutable must not be edited (compose read-only UI components rather than modifying them).
Do not introduce new backend services; keep the backend as a single Motoko actor.
nonGoals: Changing the product catalog, pricing, or product images.
Changing brand colors, typography system, or site layout beyond what is necessary to swap the logo.
